messages.content:
A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
Which conformity assessment procedure will model RC-5 need from 20 January 2027, and why?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Article 54 \"shall apply from 20 January 2027\" machinery \"regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 articolo 54 si applica a decorrere dal 20 gennaio 2027\"", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Article 25 \"conformity assessment procedure\" \"procedura di valutazione della conformità\" machinery \"organismo notificato\" Module B C H", "Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Annex IV \"machinery subject to the conformity assessment procedure\" \"allegato IV macchine per le quali è richiesto l'intervento di un organismo notificato\" lifting \"sollevamento\"", "RC-5 manual EU declaration of conformity \"dichiarazione di conformità UE\" \"manuale\" machinery category \"categoria\" \"RC-5\" \"apparecchi di sollevamento\" lifting devices list"]}
